title: Odoo's deletion protection covers five accounting models and nothing else
content:
`addons/account/models/mail_message.py` defines a module-level `DOMAINS` dict whose keys are exactly `res.company`, `account.move`, `account.account`, `account.tax` and `res.partner`, and the guard applies only where `message_type == 'tracking'`.

Everything outside that set has no deletion protection at all: purchase approvals, expense approvals, HR decisions, contract and grant awards, inventory adjustments, CRM stage changes, permission grants on `res.users`. The `@api.ondelete` hook that raises *"You cannot remove parts of a restricted audit trail"* simply does not fire for them.

The boundary is coherent — Odoo defends the statutory books, which is what it is certified for — but it means the protection an evaluator sees on a posted journal entry does not generalise to the business decisions surrounding it.
description: The DOMAINS dict in the account module lists account.move, account.account, account.tax, res.partner and res.company, so approvals outside accounting have no protection.
